_comment: AZB-21 typed classification file for scripts/sleep_gate.py. The ONLY allowlist for the sleep gate: files whose sleep lives inside one audited bounded poll loop, and function names whose sleep is a bounded poll/retry STEP (class C retry-loop idiom, v26.10.18 census rewrite-drafts/sleeps.md). Growth of this file is a reviewed diff; every entry carries a reason. Inline per-site escapes use `# SLEEP-CLASS: TIME-ADVANCE` (real time window) or `# SLEEP-CLASS: POLL-STEP` (bounded poll step) adjacent to the sleep.

files.reason: audited bounded-poll implementation; sleep is the poll step inside loop/3 with a monotonic deadline

audited bounded-poll implementation: poll_until() deadline-checked (time.monotonic deadline, typed TimeoutError); the sleep is the poll step
audited bounded-poll implementation: boundedPoll() deadline-checked with 10ms-200ms backoff cap and typed PollTimeout; sleep() at line 37 is the poll-step primitive consumed by boundedPoll
audited bounded boot-health poll: 250ms step inside a 90s deadline-checked loop polling tryConnect + /metadata/endpoints; typed SubstrateBootError + SIGKILL at deadline
